name: Kare to Kanojo to Koi no Sankaku
source:
Chika likes Natsuki. 
But Natsuki is good friends with Keita, who Chika hates. 
In order to be with Natsuki, Chika needs to like Keita. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE093352.html]DLsite English[/url]]
